lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Good morning Fabiola! Thanks for picking up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the walking went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Are you feeling okay this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, rough week. I haven't been sleeping.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's hard to think about goals when your body isn't cooperating.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Tell me how the walking went this week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, not much. My mom is staying with us and I'm taking care of her.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I want to get my energy back.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm just so tired, I don't have it in me. At least I'm trying.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Cooking a big pot on Sunday can cover two or three dinners.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You said the same thing last week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I put a reminder on the fridge. My neighbor started doing it with me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Cooking a big pot on Sunday can cover two or three dinners.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: My health is why I'm doing this. I wrote it on the calendar.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're starting to see that small changes add up.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. I got home late every day this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you cook on Sundays?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really. Okay, this week I'll really do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Cooking a big pot on Sunday can cover two or three dinners.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I made a big pot of lentils on Sunday. I don't want to end up like my dad.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If it rains I'll walk in the hallway of my building.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Wednesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

flags.reason: Unsolicited cooking advice given without permission; repeated later at lines 19 and 34.
'You have to make this a priority' pushes after coach said 'It's completely your call' at line 21.
Confronts participant ('You said the same thing last week') rather than exploring barriers.
'At least I'm trying' and 'I want to get my energy back' (line 12) were not reflected or explored.
Caregiving load and poor sleep raised; not explored for support or fatigue impact.

score.summary: The coach repeatedly pushed the same cooking advice and used directive lines like 'You have to make this a priority,' which undercut the participant's own change talk. Fabiola still produced strong commitment (Mon/Wed/Fri plan, reminders, barrier planning), but the coach did not reflect it or summarize the plan.
strengths: Line 10 affirmed the participant's honesty, building rapport.
Line 21 emphasized autonomy, and lines 36-37 planned for barriers well.
Line 24 affirmed small gains, and the call ended with a scheduled next contact at line 38.
coaching_tips: Stop repeating the Sunday cooking suggestion (lines 15, 19, 34); ask permission first, e.g., 'Would it help to hear one idea for meal prep?'
Replace line 22 with a reflection that honors autonomy, e.g., 'You've decided on Monday, Wednesday and Friday, and that's your call.'
Reflect change talk at lines 12 and 25 with complex reflections, such as 'Getting your energy back matters, and you feel better when you follow through.'
Summarize the plan before closing: days, barriers (rain, hallway walking), and support from your neighbor.
